changeinfo.changes:
The following issues have been fixed:
  • Online games no longer timeout when 3G is used.
  • Network games now give more specific error messages when connectivity is affected by restricted NAT type.
  • Career mode stability has been improved after one or two full careers.
  • Changing teams after the ball has been placed no longer causes a crash.
  • Half-time and full-time scrum stats are now displayed correctly.
  • Team rating in an online private match lobby now reflects the value listed in the main menu.
  • The 'Rating' text in an online private match lobby no longer overlaps the team name.
  • Italian: The trophy description now contains the correct spelling of 'Rugby'.
